title: Verse 16:1 — perfective tense for a future event

slides.translation: The decree of Allah has come — so do not seek to hasten it.
slides.annotation: the past-tense form, used for an event still ahead in time

slides.alternativeGloss: The decree of Allah is coming
slides.saidGloss: The decree of Allah has come
slides.tagline: the past tense, treating the future as already done

slides.translation: The decree of Allah has come — so do not seek to hasten it.
slides.annotation: certainty doesn't wait for our clocks

slides.tagline: A Root Based Translation of the Quran
